description: Adds a variant to an existing product, e.g. a new size. 'options' must name every product option; new option values are added automatically.

allow_backorder.description: Allow selling when out of stock

location_id.description: Stock location for initial stock; defaults to the only one

options.description: Option title -> value, e.g. { Size: 'M', Color: 'Red' }

stock.description: Initial stocked quantity at location_id (or the only location)

title.description: Defaults to the option values, e.g. 'M / Red'

name: create_variant
title: Create variant
